grid = np.array(test_input)

print(f"Full row indices: {sorted(full_row_indices)}")
print(f"Full col indices: {sorted(full_col_indices)}")

row_segments = []
prev = -1
for i in sorted(full_row_indices):

    prev = i

    row_segments.append((prev + 1, grid.shape[0] - 1))

print(f"\nRow segments: {row_segments}")

# For each segment, count rows and analyze non-skeleton cells
for start, end in row_segments:
    num_rows = end - start + 1
    print(f"\nRows {start}-{end} ({num_rows} rows):")
    for r in range(start, min(end+1, grid.shape[0])):
        # Check which cells differ from background
        row = list(grid[r])
